prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Home wait_info changes are consistently helpful, winning 5 out of 9 tests.
Adoption redesigns are generally helpful, winning 2 out of 3 tests.
Choose_path updates (copy, layout, redesign) showed no positive effect, ranging from no clear effect to performing worse across multiple tests.
Finish hints, sign-in notifications, and sign-in redesigns showed no positive effect, frequently leading to negative impacts or early test stops.
Adoption hints, home redesigns, finish layouts, finish new flows, sign-in copy, and sign-in incentives showed no clear effect across 2 or 3 tests each.
Predictions were systematically too low for big winning changes and too high for changes with no clear effect or negative outcomes; single-test categories remain thin evidence.

Changes:
0: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Habitat Construction Progress Display: Displays live habitat construction milestones and sound toggle info while waiting for pet generation. (why: Home wait_info updates consistently perform well in tests, and waiting screen median time is long (201s).)
1: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Character Showcase Stage Redesign: Redesigns the friend selection screen into a stage layout featuring animated previews and trait cards for each companion archetype. (why: Adoption redesigns have a 2/3 win rate in previous tests, helping users select their preferred pet faster.)
2: [finish, new_flow] Home Intro Desktop Docking Guided Walkthrough Flow: Introduces a new interactive step in the finish stage that guides users through pet desktop controls, docking, and hiding features. (why: Support received multiple complaints about confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after onboarding.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Existing Account Sync Safety Hint: Adds a clear hint on the sign-in screen assuring users that signing in prevents pet data resets and sync loss. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again, making account sync clarity crucial.)
4: [finish, redesign] Home Intro Split Guide Desktop Setup Redesign: Redesigns the finish onboarding screen into a split view showing pet interaction shortcuts alongside live desktop visibility status. (why: Finish step has a high median time (395s) and 82.4% conversion; clear visual instructions prevent post-onboarding confusion.)
5: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Companion Customization Teaser Display: Displays animated customization tips and feature teasers during the waiting screen progress phase. (why: Home wait_info changes consistently win tests, and waiting screen median time is 201s.)
6: [choose_path, copy] Choose Path Companion Archetype Headline Simplification: Replaces the choose path headline with simpler, benefit-oriented text clarifying pre-made vs custom pet options. (why: Choose path mean completion time is very high (514s) despite median 8s, indicating user confusion on path selection.)
7: [adoption, wait_info] Upload Photos Guidance and Clarity Wait Info: Displays clear photo requirements and sample image previews during photo selection. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet failures or bad results during generation.)
